title: The Means of Persuading
wikitext: {{Questbox | name=The Means of Persuading | start=[[Prison Guards's Coffee Mug]] | end=[[Incompleted Interrogation Report]] | faction=Alliance | id= | level=60 | type= | category=Menethil Harbor | experience = | rewards = | previous = [[Are You True to Your Nature?]] | next = [[The Price Of Information]] }} == Objectives == Use your persuasion skills to interrogate Vladeus. * Obtain information from Vladeus == Description == During your many adventures through Azeroth you have faced several perils and foes, unlike the man present before you. You are more than sure he's not a wicked sort and chose to approach this lightly, staying true to your nature. With a table full of choices you pick the best means of persuasion and are ready to begin. == Progress == The report seems incomplete, other than some basic information of the prisoner there's really nothing useful there. == Completion == Reaching for the quill and ink, you note the information you extracted from Vladeus thus finalizing the report. ==Notes== ;Speaking with Vladeus Springriver What are they going to do to me? I am sorry for all I have done, I really am. I regret all of it, and given the chance I will surely make amends. :{{gossip|''Vladeus Springriver, from Lakeshire, is it?''}} : Vladeus remains silent while slightly nodding his head, the nod is followed by a cough. You assume his throat was parched after being in chains for so long. :{{gossip|''Offer water to Vladeus.''}} :'''Vladeus Springriver says:''' Thank you, you're the one that captured me, right? I am grateful you spared my life but there's nothing I can tell you. :{{gossip|''Please Vladeus, make this easier for both of us. You look like a decent man, the people of Lakeshire wanted me to bring all of you back.''}} :''Vladeus cries.'' :'''Vladeus Springriver says:''' A bit late for that don't you think? Since you took the life of the rest, I have nothing to tell you, the man in the red hood would return home and ki... I have said too much. :{{gossip|''There is nothing to fear with me at your side, the Alliance will protect your family. The Scarlet Crusade already failed so many times.''}} :'''Vladeus Springriver says:''' Perhaps you are right. I didn't really want it to end this way, we were promised a better life, we... I... I didn't expect they'd make me kill innocents, you have to believe me! :{{gossip|''I do, take my word for it. Who recruited you and why?''}} :'''Vladeus Springriver says:''' I didn't see his face clearly, he was wearing a red hood and was simply laughing every few minutes. Looking back, it was the stupidest choice I have ever made. As to why they recruited us, I am not really sure. He said we would be taken to a hidden place of the Crusade to be trained, he was complaining that their number was low and since the death of two of their leaders they became broken. I think he mentioned a name, Aventis or Adentis? :{{gossip|''Abbendis?''}} :'''Vladeus Springriver says:''' Yes, that's the one! Please I don't know anything else, I wish to return home. ==Progression== {{Scarlet Citadel Alliance Attunement}}
